Take the Bay Area by the handlebars: Single rides. Day passes. Annual memberships. Whether you’re a longtime local or just visiting, we’ve got options to help you get where you’re going. And back again.
Lyft Bike: Member-only perks: For less than a dollar a day, you get unlimited 45-minute rides on classic bikes, reduced ebike prices, $0 unlocks, and a whole lot more.

Lyft Bike: Member-only perks: Angels take bikes from crowded stations to empty stations, making the system work better for everyone. In return, they earn points toward ebike credits, free membership extensions, and badges. Learn more.
Lyft Bike: Member-only perks: Get access to new features before anyone else, and get an opportunity to tell us how we can improve the rider experience.
Lyft Bike: Member-only perks: Enjoy food tours, group rides, and more.
Lyft Bike: Member-only perks: Longer ride times. Reserve-ahead features. Being a member means you get more good stuff.
Short-term options: Lyft Bike offers day passes and single rides so you can ride casually without committing to a membership.
Single rides: $1.00 to unlock
Single rides: $0.19/min for classic bikes. $0.49/minute for ebikes.
Day pass: When you’ve got lots to do. Includes unlimited 30-min classic bike rides within a 24-hour period. Any ride longer than 30 min is an extra $0.19/min. Upgrading to an ebike is also $0.49/min.
Day pass: $15/day
Bikeshare for All: We’re expanding access to bikeshare through $5 memberships for qualifying residents. No annual commitment required.
